The Free plan explicitly limits active projects to 25 cards, and exporting a partial PDF from an over-limit list is not permitted. You can either trim the list or consider upgrading to a paid plan (e.g., Event Pass, Planner Pro, or Studio) for higher limits.

Answer or offer a registered customer-clicked route; do not navigate or create a case automatically.
